defense_news.title: US Army launches laser production with $465M contract award
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army awarded a $464.8 million production contract to AeroVironment, Inc., this week for the Enduring-High Energy Laser program.

defense_news.title: The Army shut down a specialized drone unit. Legislators want to know why.
defense_news.summary: A bipartisan group of lawmakers asked the Army to explain why it is shuttering a specialized drone battalion less than a year after establishing it.

defense_news.title: Defense firms soar on ample military spending, testing manufacturing schemes
defense_news.summary: For the many billions of dollars governments spend on defense, companies are on the hook to get their production pipelines in place and deliver.
